name: Documented stack CLI capabilities
scope: Distributed metadata, not a bulk installer, installed state or runtime observations.
auto_install_policy: Selected necessary project-local tools may be installed under the owner authorization using the canonical Environment/skill-owned-tools workflow. No install-all, global runtime changes, arbitrary catalog command execution or implied network permission.

tools.notes: Use discovered python/python3/py -3. venv is a Python module, not a separate pip package. Creating .venv writes files and requires selected project scope; no automatic system Python installation.

tools.name: React via create-vite
tools.version_policy: Reuse project lock and installed version; otherwise resolve and record an exact compatible version before execution. VERSION is not executable text.
tools.capability: Bootstrap a React SPA when the approved architecture calls for Vite.
tools.notes: React has no single first-party generator. Vite is a tool documented by React, not a React-owned CLI. Choose architecture first; never re-scaffold existing applications or install deprecated Create React App for a new project. Choose react for JavaScript/JSX or react-ts for TypeScript; retain React 19 if that is the approved version instead of accepting a future template default.

tools.name: Nx CLI
tools.capability: Generate workspace applications/libraries and enforce configured module dependency boundaries.
tools.notes: Architecture defines domain boundaries first; Nx does not discover them or guarantee a modular monolith. Reuse native Nest/project generators when sufficient. Select matching @nx plugin versions and existing manager; inspect generator options and dry-run support. Never introduce Nx, Nx Cloud, remote caches, service-per-module containers or workspace migration without project need and approved scope. Nx Cloud and enterprise functionality are separate optional services; no account linking implied.

tools.name: OpenTofu CLI
tools.capability: Describe, plan and provision selected cloud or on-premises infrastructure through providers.
tools.notes: Catalog adoption authorizes research/selection, not provisioning. Environment chooses official OS/architecture-specific installation, pin and checksum verification; no arbitrary curl-to-shell or privileged install assumed. Reuse current Terraform/OpenTofu toolchain and state, no automatic migration. init may download provider/module code or access backend state; plan may access APIs, execute data sources, lock state and expose sensitive values. Neither is presumed offline or harmless. apply, destroy, import and state mutations require concrete target-specific authorization. Keep credentials, state and saved plans outside committed source. No resource creation, paid service, container, merge or deploy is authorized by this entry.
